lines.text: This twenty-six storey tower isn't for people... It's for pigs!
Uh-joe, central China. A cement company builds two pig skyscrapers.
Lifts carry about sixty pigs at a time, up to their floors.
Together, the towers can produce over a million pigs a year.
And they need people. More than eight hundred of them.
A vet graduate working there said he earned about twenty thousand yuen a month.
The catch? Before work: shower, a sixty-five degree drying room...
A nozzle even shampoos your hair, so nobody skips it!
And staff lived on site for up to two months at a time.
In China, jobs hide in places you'd never look. Find yours at Lao-why dot mah.
